searchText: hey folks! back from the holidays! couple of thoughts: 1. I think specifying `builder_index` in the registrations might get tricky in the builder-api. The validator would have to know the `builder_index` corresponding to a builder which could change dynamically. how would i know the builder indices corresponding to a builder A given their url or so? 2. I think registration replaying can be avoided today with the `timestamp` field in the registration object right? https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/specs/bellatrix/builder.md?plain=1#L71 With ePBS, we can have the timestamp field act as versioning and builders could only accept registrations with a later timestamp than what they have already seen? Since the registration is signed by validator, builders can't send a fake registration builders could expose an endpoint which lists their indices and based on that we could populate the registrations with the builder indices but that doesn't seem too clean. Builders should advertise the builder index in their endpoint. Replays are JIT thats fair but a builder could also have multiple builder indices right? i would assume a proposer could query the builder for the indices every epoch when they have to create a registration Yes Registration is not important for the builder index It's important at the bid request time You can remove the builder index from the registration, there it's kinda irrelevant or a minor dos in making a builder prepare a payload that will not be requested. But the builder index needs to come in the bid request. If there's a list of indices or multiple requests per endpoint that's another story, both are fine by me agreed, i think it could add more complexity for validators as they have to fetch the indices somehow while creating the registrations just to clarify, when you mean "builder index needs to come in the bid request", you mean the validator would have to send the builder_index from which they want the bid? because the `ExecutionPayloadBid` already includes the `builder_index`. When a validator queries a builder url, it should get the builders best `ExecutionPayloadBid` This is in the config file, just like MeV boost in my mind, i was thinking of cases where a builder could change their builder index. but i don't think a builder would change it regularly anyways Yes! This is the whole point of signing to a builder to prevent anyone to request a current quote from said builder yup makes sense. we want only the proposer to be able to query the bid. so it should be ideally safe to assume that the validators will know the builder index of a given builder url It's fine if the builder changes by just having a list and rotate them, that gives them a buffer to change configurations on proposers as long as they don't rotate too often yeah i would assume changing the builder index is akin to changing their url. today if a builder changes their url, it would be a big undertaking to advertise it to all proposers i think thats clear! thanks! i m finishing up the builder-api specs and will let you folks know when it is ready to review!

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content:
hey folks! back from the holidays! couple of thoughts:
1. I think specifying `builder_index` in the registrations might get tricky in the builder-api. The validator would have to know the `builder_index` corresponding to a builder which could change dynamically.  how would i know the builder indices corresponding to a builder A given their url or so?
2. I think registration replaying can be avoided today with the `timestamp` field in the registration object right? https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/specs/bellatrix/builder.md?plain=1#L71 With ePBS, we can have the timestamp field act as versioning and builders could only accept registrations with a later timestamp than what they have already seen? Since the registration is signed by validator, builders can't send a fake registration

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: builders could expose an endpoint which lists their indices and based on that we could populate the registrations with the builder indices but that doesn't seem too clean.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Builders should advertise the builder index in their endpoint.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Replays are JIT

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: thats fair but a builder could also have multiple builder indices right?

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: i would assume a proposer could query the builder for the indices every epoch when they have to create a registration

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Yes

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Registration is not important for the builder index

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: It's important at the bid request time

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: You can remove the builder index from the registration, there it's kinda irrelevant or a minor dos in making a builder prepare a payload that will not be requested.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: But the builder index needs to come in the bid request. If there's a list of indices or multiple requests per endpoint that's another story, both are fine by me

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: agreed, i think it could add more complexity for validators as they have to fetch the indices somehow while creating the registrations

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: just to clarify, when you mean "builder index needs to come in the bid request", you mean the validator would have to send the builder_index from which they want the bid? because the `ExecutionPayloadBid` already includes the `builder_index`. When a validator queries a builder url, it should get the builders best `ExecutionPayloadBid`

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: This is in the config file, just like MeV boost

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: in my mind, i was thinking of cases where a builder could change their builder index. but i don't think a builder would change it regularly anyways

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Yes! This is the whole point of signing to a builder to prevent anyone to request a current quote from said builder

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: yup makes sense. we want only the proposer to be able to query the bid.

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: so it should be ideally safe to assume that the validators will know the builder index of a given builder url

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: It's fine if the builder changes by just having a list and rotate them, that gives them a buffer to change configurations on proposers as long as they don't rotate too often

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: yeah i would assume changing the builder index is akin to changing their url. today if a builder changes their url, it would be a big undertaking to advertise it to all proposers

excerpts.author: bharath.vedartham
excerpts.content: i think thats clear! thanks! i m finishing up the builder-api specs and will let you folks know when it is ready to review!
